verdict.rationale: Otter's own marketing claims "speaker recognition" with live transcription, and its pricing page lists "taggable speakers", so it does have first-party diarization and a way to attach names to speakers. Both are bare one-line claims, with no detail on accuracy or on whether named speakers are matched automatically or tagged by hand. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic real-name matching (e.g., from calendar or voice profiles), evidence on diarization accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration of correct speaker attribution.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
